audit.whatIsWrong: The lane's decisive interaction was never stated: Ethereal Chains is a shackle, not an instant root. It only roots if you are still tethered 1.5 seconds later, and Astral Flight is the break — the whole reason the flight must never be spent on poke.
audit.why: Enemy E: 'LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.' Range 925, cooldown 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11. Owner W Astral Flight travels 1500 on a 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 cooldown. The root is also what ends Breath of Light, which carries the channel flag — so the chain is simultaneously her burst setup and her answer to your beam.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dontsFull[0].d, phases[3].why, spikes[0].text, early, mid and wants.you[1]: fly to break the shackle inside 1.5 seconds, and bank the flight for exactly that.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors in the content layer: wants.foe[0] says 'Land Sigil (W)' — Sigil of Malice is her Q, her W is Distortion — and mid tells the player to survive her level-6 combo 'without flashing or using Voidlink defensively'. Voidlink is not an Aurelion Sol ability and does not exist in this kit.
audit.why: Enemy slots: Q Sigil of Malice (700, 6s), W Distortion (600 dash, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10, 4-second return window), E Ethereal Chains (925), R Mimic (45/35/25). Owner E is the black hole — 750 range, 12s, a slow pull with an execute centre, not a defensive tool at all.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now names Sigil of Malice (Q); mid now points at the real defensive resource, Astral Flight banked to break the shackle. Also fixed wants.you[1], which referred to 'both Distortion charges' — Distortion has no charges, it has one dash and a 4-second return.

audit.whatIsWrong: LeBlanc is female and the full layer addresses her as male throughout: 'his favourite food', 'his answer range', 'his engage range', 'his roam timers', 'his shove', 'his tower', 'Make him flinch first'. Ten fields.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists leblanc as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun refers to LeBlanc.
audit.corrected: All corrected to she/her, and the difficulty framing regrounded on the real problem — a 925 shackle that both sets up the burst and cancels your channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two level-chart rows rendered two answers: full phases[5].side='LeBlanc' vs content win[5]='Aurelion Sol', and phases[6].side='Skill' vs win[6]='Aurelion Sol'. Separately, phases[4].side='LeBlanc' agreed with win[4] but its why described the OWNER winning that stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [LeBlanc x5, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol] and agrees with the content layer. The existing phases[5].why ('the stardust curve bends upward for good') and phases[6].why ('You are the scaling endgame') both already describe the owner winning, so the sides were the outlier. phases[4].why, by contrast, said 'Falling Star online — the self-peel stun your kit was missing... his dive math suddenly has a second variable' under a LeBlanc verdict, which is the row-argues-with-itself defect.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side moved to Aurelion Sol as one group; phases[4].why rewritten in the same proposal to justify the LeBlanc verdict via Mimic's 45s recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and whys[6] credit Aurelion Sol with 'global threat' / a 'long-range ultimate', and several fields describe a pre-rework 'stars' kit.
audit.why: Falling Star is 1250 range on a 120/110/100 cooldown — not global. The owner kit is Breath of Light (750 channel), Astral Flight, the black hole, and Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real scaling story: stardust-stacked beam damage plus The Skies Descend against a burst kit that has nothing once its combo is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — only 'Dash with a four-second return window' as words.
audit.why: Real numbers: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10 at 600 with a 4-second return, Ethereal Chains 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11 at 925, Sigil of Malice 6 flat at 700, Mimic 45/35/25.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries all four, and dosFull[2].d's existing 'fifteen-second invitation' is now stated as the real 15s at rank 1 (that figure was already correct — I kept it and made the rank explicit).

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d under 'Hold Flash + R as a paired dive answer' carried the tradeGood string verbatim, and dontsFull[2].d under 'Contest her shove pre-item spike' carried the tradeBad string verbatim.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten around Falling Star landing on the Distortion return spot and the Mirror Image clone dealing no damage; dontsFull[2].d rewritten around the sub-40% passive that gives her a clone and a second of invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Templated fields carried from other matchups: enemyWin, ahead, breakdown.carry, breakdown.early, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d.
audit.why: Template sweep — each reads identically on other enemies with the ability name swapped.
audit.corrected: All rewritten against LeBlanc's real numbers and pattern inside the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Killed a second sighting of 'Voidlink' — an ability that does not exist in Aurelion Sol's kit — this time in the content mid field, where it was offered as the player's defensive answer to her level-6 combo. It also appeared in the katarina matchup. Worth grepping the whole champion for it. Also fixed a wrong slot: wants.foe[0] called Sigil of Malice her W; it is her Q, and Distortion is the W. The 'fifteen-second invitation' in dosFull[2].d turned out to be CORRECT (Distortion really is 15s at rank 1) — I kept the number and made the rank explicit rather than 'fixing' it. As with karma and katarina, I declined the supplied missingInteraction claiming Astral Flight shuts off Distortion: it derives from a terrain flag that contradicts Riot's text ('Aurelion Sol flies over terrain'), and he creates no terrain. Level chart: full phases[5].side and phases[6].side disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart; fixed both, and separately rewrote phases[4].why, which described the owner winning a stage the row awards to LeBlanc.
